title: I love this APP
body:
I have a toxic, non-consensual relationship with Alarmy, and I have never been more in love.
Before Alarmy, my morning routine consisted of hitting snooze for 90 minutes, gaslighting myself into believing I didn't actually need my job, and eventually waking up with the panic of a cornered animal.
Enter Alarmy—the digital equivalent of a drill sergeant who has access to your bank account and no soul.
Why this app is a masterpiece of psychological warfare:
• The Math Mission: Nothing says "good morning" like being forced to solve (34 x 7) + 89 while completely blind and vibrating with rage. I used to think I was bad at math. Turns out, I just needed the threat of a deafening air horn to unlock my inner Einstein.
• The Photo Mission: I set my wake-up trigger to a photo of my bathroom sink. Do you know what it’s like to sprint down the hallway in pitch darkness, aggressively framing a porcelain basin while an app screams at you like you're trying to defuse a bomb? It’s exhilarating. I feel like Jason Bourne, if Jason Bourne was wearing dinosaur pajamas and crying.
• The Squat Mission: Yes, I have done 20 squats at 6:00 AM just to silence my phone. My legs are toned, my cortisol levels are through the roof, and my dog thinks I’ve joined a cult.
This app doesn’t just wake you up; it aggressively evicts you from your own dream state. It is relentless, it is cruel, and it is the only reason I am a functioning member of society. 5 out of 5 stars. I hate it here, but I’m never leaving.

title: Great, gentle but effective
body:
I have issues with my sleep rhythms due to a chronic illness. I stopped setting alarms for a long while because I thought it would be best to let my body naturally choose its wake up time when it had had enough rest. But I was waking up later and later in the day and still felt groggy and wrong. Turns out, because of my body’s inability to regulate itself, it couldn’t regulate an appropriate wake up time either. 

But alarms were a problem. I’d obviously tried normal alarms before, but they were always harsh and insistent and even if I set a gentle tone, just didn’t have much flexibility so I would just turn them off and end up going back to sleep.

Alarmy is different. I’m still experimenting, but so far I love the feature of the alarm getting gradually louder and having so much flexibility around volume, as it enables me to wake myself up very gently and gradually. I then use one of the activities to ensure I don’t just turn the alarm off and go back to sleep. It’s been about a week now and I’ve woken up at the same time every single day. I haven’t been able to do this in months.

Highly recommend.

body:

Firstly, the alarm itself is great. The free version is pretty limited but you’ve got enough access that it’s still worth it. It succeeded in waking me up properly every time it actually went off. 

Unfortunately it only works if the app is open in the background and your phone is not on silent. If your phone is on silent though, it only vibrates, no sound. My phone is always on silent so this makes the app useless to me.

In the last 5 years the only times it hasn’t worked is when I myself did not set it up correctly or I forgot entirely. If you’re considering getting this app then I would encourage you to try it, especially if you are struggling with waking up and staying up. In fact I would recommend alarmy even if it had a fraction of the features it has now, that is how invaluable this app is to me. This app helped me function in my dysfunction and has saved me from being late Countless times. Also if you are curious about the premium features I would say if you can afford it and you feel you need as much help as possible then get it. I would also ask you to consider this, when you factor in this could help you keep a job or even get promoted, this app quickly pays itself off, just a thought. body:

1. You need to keep it open 24/7, otherwise alarms don’t work.  There is such a thing as background app refreshing and I don’t understand why they don’t use it.

title: WAKE UP, WORK ON TIME!!!
body:

Now that I have a professional job offer, I have to wake up at 5:30-6am to get to the field on time!!!
ALARMY has done exactly what it's meant to do. No 'visible snoozing button'. I put on shake mode (medium high - high) and I really have to sit up to shake it properly!
After training myself using this app, I'm not late for work! 
Plus, it has indicative weather/temperature so for people who are sensitive to weather changes like me, it's really important. I like how you show it immediately after the mission is completed. I'm too lazy to check weather apps everyday. 
Thanks much for developing this app and allowing users to have to for 0 cost. Supporting you by watching a couple of apps is the least we can do. :)
Personally, one particular feature I'd love to see is that I have the option to see different weather zones after my area. My work place is 1 hour driving from my place and it might be raining over there, for example. 
Anyway, so far so good. Keep it up!! Thanks again team.
